guia.what: A boolean checkbox. Supports an indeterminate state, a description (`ts checkbox-description`), card mode (`is-card`), an error (`is-invalid`), and grouping with `ts checkbox-group`, which includes “select all” (`data-ts-select-all`).
whenUse: A yes/no option that’s confirmed when the form is submitted (terms, a flag).
Choosing several items from a list, inside a `ts checkbox-group`.
You need the indeterminate state (a partial “select all”).
You need to show an error or hint right next to the checkbox, on its own or inside the `field` markup.
whenAvoid: The change applies immediately, not on submit → `toggle`.
dos: Write a clear, positive label, so checking it means what it says.
Group several related checkboxes with `ts checkbox-group`.
If the label alone isn’t enough to decide, add a description (`has-description`). The `is-card` mode works when each option is a card (a plan, a channel).
A group error (`Choose at least one channel.`) goes once on the group, not repeated on every checkbox.
donts: Don’t use it for a setting that takes effect immediately → `toggle`.
Don’t build a group where only one can be checked → `radio`.
Don’t use `is-card` for a standalone accept-the-terms checkbox. Cards are for choosing between options.

nucleo: It’s a native `<input type="checkbox">`. The browser handles focus, keyboard, and form submission. To paint the state, Core mirrors `checked` to the label’s `is-checked` class. The error, hint, and description are markup the example already includes. A group (`ts checkbox-group`) with a “select all” checkbox (`data-ts-select-all` on the parent checkbox). It checks or unchecks all the others, and turns mixed (`indeterminate`) when only some are checked.
